summary: KT Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing termination of its treasury share trust agreement with NH Investment Securities, effective September 9, 2026. The trust's full 250,000,000,000 KRW was deployed, acquiring 4,480,551 common shares from April 30 to August 31, 2026, at monthly amounts of roughly 37.5-58.9 billion KRW; the final purchase was slightly reduced to avoid exceeding the cap. Post-termination, KT holds 15,296,024 treasury shares, 6.07% of common stock (706,260 million KRW), including 10,815,473 previously direct. Watch for cancellation, resale, or further buyback signaling and any overhang impact on the shares.
